description: Bridges on local road network by municipality and year provides national municipal statistics for permanent and temporary bridges on local roads, measured as counts and lengths. The provider is State Statistical Office, North Macedonia. Geographical and temporal coverage: North Macedonia's statistical table covers 2012 to 2025 and was updated on 19 June 2026. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: Municipal aggregate lengths and counts do not supply bridge coordinates, condition or load capacity. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
